items.source_en:
PART II
As the sun began to set, fear started to creep into the hearts of the groats. It was then that one curious and brave groat noticed something.

He saw that the brush, though thick, could be eaten. Knowing that they were in big trouble, the young groat decided to act. He took a deep breath and began to munch on the tangled branches and leaves, slowly creating a path forward.

The other groats, inspired by the young Groat, began to join one by one in eating away at the brush. As the groats worked together, their path home widened. The shepherd's calls grew closer until they were finally reunited and returned safely to the peaceful meadow.
